title: mcpmoat scan output
description: The JSON document that `mcpmoat scan --json` writes to stdout. The document never holds env or header values. A finding names the key it is about, never the value. Text fields that come from servers or config files are untrusted: non-printable and invisible non-ASCII characters are written as \uXXXX escapes.

schema_version.description: Version of this output format. It is 1 for this schema.

mode.description: How the scan ran. "no-connect" only reads configs. "connect" also connects to the servers.

servers.description: Every server that the scan found. Empty list when there is none.

findings.description: Every finding that is not ignored. Empty list when there is none.

diffs.description: One diff for each tool that differs from the pins. Empty list when there is none.

errors.description: Config problems that the scan found. Empty list when there is none.

tool.description: The program that made the report.

server.description: One MCP server from a client config. The document has no env, no header and no working directory.

name.description: Server name from the config. Untrusted text.

client.description: The client whose config declares the server.

scope.description: "global" for a user-wide config. "project" for a server of one project.

project_path.description: Path of the project for a project server. Empty string means none. Untrusted text.

untrusted.description: True for a server from a project file, which a cloned repository can ship.

state.description: Whether the client config turns the server on. "project-approved" means that only files from the repository approved the server. "unknown" is the fallback for a state that this version does not know.

transport.description: How mcpmoat talks to the server.

source.description: Path of the config file that declares the server. Untrusted text.

argv.description: Command line of a stdio server. It is redacted: secret-looking values are masked. Absent for http and sse servers.

url.description: URL of an http or sse server. It is redacted: credentials and secret-looking parts are masked. Absent for stdio servers.

inspection.description: What happened when mcpmoat inspected the server.

status.description: "not_run": mcpmoat did not connect. This happens in no-connect mode. It also happens in connect mode when the inspection or the pin step fails as a whole (for example, pins.json cannot be read): then every server is "not_run", the exit code is 2 and the reason is on stderr. "ok": it connected and listed the tools. "timeout": the server did not answer in time. "failed": the connection or the tool list failed. "refused": mcpmoat chose not to connect, for example to a disabled or untrusted server.

finding.description: One finding. For every string field, an empty string means that the field does not apply.

rule_id.description: ID of the rule that matched, for example MOAT-T2-004.

severity.description: Severity word of the rule. Known values are "low", "medium", "high" and "critical". This is a plain string, not an enum, because the Go code accepts any string here and treats an unknown value as failing. Consumers must handle other values.

server.description: Name of the server that the finding is about. Untrusted text. Empty string means none.

field.description: Config field that matched, for example "env" or "args". Empty string means none.

key.description: Key name in the field, for example an env variable name. Only keys, never values. Untrusted text. Empty string means none.

related.description: A second name that the finding refers to, for example a second server, or a fixed reason text. Untrusted text. Empty string means none.

diff.description: The diff of one tool against its pin.

server.description: Name of the server. Untrusted text.

tool.description: Name of the tool. Untrusted text.

kind.description: "changed": the pinned and the current text differ. "new": the server offers a tool that the pins do not hold. "unverified": a pinned tool whose pin cannot be checked.

diff.description: Unified diff as raw server text. It is untrusted. JSON escaping covers control characters, and non-printable or invisible non-ASCII characters are written as \uXXXX escapes. Do not write it to a terminal without care.

diff_truncated.description: True when the stored diff was cut, so "diff" is not the whole diff.

fileError.description: One config problem. The text of the underlying error is never included.

path.description: Path of the config file. Untrusted text.

project_path.description: Path of the project for a project config. Empty string means none. Untrusted text.

server.description: Name of the server that the problem is about. Empty string means a problem with the whole file. Untrusted text.

line.description: 1-based line of the problem. 0 means unknown.

col.description: 1-based byte column of the problem. 0 means unknown.

reason.description: Fixed text that tells what is wrong.

untrusted.description: True when the problem is in a project file, which a cloned repository can ship.
